description: Windows service that controls automatic COM port number assignment.
notes: ComPortMan runs as a Windows service. To register it, open an elevated shell in the app directory and run _service_register.cmd
Settings live in ComPortMan.ini, which is persisted across updates. Run _edit_ini.cmd to edit it.
